metadata.datasource: Agfa Datenblatt APX 400, status 08/1995, 1st edition; SHA256 dbce281b8618e6ba96897917482cb5e17933d1c4d499e7f9f056233eb2a4143a. Reproduce with scripts/bw_expansion/prepare_bw_film.py; axis calibration derived from the page by scripts/bw_expansion/extract_graphs.py; source points, assumptions and conditions: data/profile-sources/agfa-apx400/recipe.json. PCHIP of the single plotted log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. The trace spans 379.97-664.93 nm and meets the panel's floor at 664.5 nm, so it is truncated at 660 nm. That truncation is an explicit unmeasured-tail approximation, not proof of zero red sensitivity. The sheet does not label the density curve with a developer or time, and the sheet cannot place it. Measured average gradient is 0.530 over 1.3 decades and 0.548 over 1.5, from the point 0.1 above base. Every curve on the sheet's own gamma-time panel lies at or above about 0.55 across its whole plotted time range, so no developer and time on this datasheet produces the contrast the density panel shows. The conditions are therefore unknown and not inferable; 6 minutes, Refinal's recommended time, is recorded as a nominal label only.
